meta_description: GS Painting & Decorating in Leicester. Expert interior and exterior painting, decorating, and specialist finishes. Free quotes, local family business.
hero_eyebrow: Local Leicester Painter — Trustworthy, Professional Finish
hero_subhead: From fresh interior walls to complete exterior transformations, we deliver professional results on time and on budget across Leicester.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: Whether you need a fresh coat indoors or exterior work that lasts, we handle everything from prep to perfect finish.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Professional interior painting for living spaces, bedrooms, and kitchens. We prep surfaces properly, use quality paints, and deliver a flawless finish that transforms your home.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's exterior with durable exterior paint and render work. Weather-resistant finishes designed to last and keep your home looking sharp.

services.title: Feature Walls & Specialist Effects
services.desc: Create impact with feature walls, faux finishes, and bespoke colour schemes. From contemporary to traditional, we bring your design vision to life.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Expert painting of doors, skirting boards, frames, and other woodwork. We sand, prime, and finish to a standard that catches light perfectly.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Offices, shops, and commercial spaces need reliable, disruptive-free painting. We work around your business schedule and leave sites clean and ready to trade.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Precision wallpaper hanging and removal. Walls are prepared perfectly so every seam is invisible and your new scheme looks professionally installed.

about_pullquote: Every room we paint is someone's home — we treat it like our own.
about_para_1: GS Painting & Decorating was founded on a simple belief: good decorating shouldn't be a lottery. We've built our reputation over 12 years by showing up on time, doing the job properly, and standing behind our work. From small flat redecoration to full house projects, we've earned the trust of hundreds of Leicester families.
about_para_2: Customers choose us because we listen, we're transparent about costs, and we leave your home spotless when we're done. We use quality materials, prepare surfaces thoroughly, and don't cut corners. That's why so many people call us back for their next project — and why their neighbours ask for our number.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had GS in to paint our whole downstairs. Excellent attention to detail, very professional, and they left the place immaculate. Quote was fair and they stuck to it. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: David T.
reviews.loc: Houghton on the Hill, Leicester — September 2024

reviews.text: Needed our kitchen and bathroom done quickly before family visit. The team were responsive, flexible with timing, and the finish is brilliant. Really happy with the colour choices they suggested too.
reviews.author: Margaret H.

reviews.text: Exterior of our house needed a complete refresh. They prepared everything properly, used good quality paint, and you can see the difference from down the street. Professional job all the way.
reviews.author: James M.
